ideas.pitch: A real-time syntax and logic visualizer built specifically to train students for blind coding challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Blind Coding: A unique, high-intensity challenge where you code without viewing your monitor.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Blind Coding event format at DCRUST, giving judges an interactive tool to evaluate mental compilation skills.

ideas.pitch: An interactive step-by-step state transition animator for complex dynamic programming and optimization problems.

ideas.title: DP-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the core demographic of DCRUST's competitive programming festival by solving the hardest hurdle in DSA battles: visualizing state tables.

ideas.pitch: A gamified IoT resource monitoring and allocation platform designed to optimize energy and water consumption across the university campus.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovation Competition: Build future solutions and pitch your ideas to prove your technical creativity.
ideas.title: CampusGreen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven track record of Smart India Hackathon winners by tackling institutional sustainability with a working live demo.

ideas.pitch: An automated multi-agent code review assistant that detects algorithmic inefficiencies and anti-patterns in real-time competitive programming submissions.
